topic.source_contract: main-river designation, flood risk activity permits, exemptions, ordinary watercourse consent and delivery

scope_guards: Proximity to a watercourse is not treated as a permit requirement without exact classification and geometry.
A main-river map entry is not treated as land ownership or access rights.
Planning permission is not treated as a flood risk activity permit.
An exemption is not treated as valid unless registered and all conditions are met.
A permit application is not treated as a granted permit.
Ordinary-watercourse and main-river consent routes are not conflated.
A concept design is not treated as constructed, reinstated or compliant works.
No score or promotion is written without exact river status, permission, rights, risk controls and completion evidence.
